entries.title: Cell Membrane Transport and Vesicle Traffic
entries.description: A transparent spherical cell with a semi-permeable membrane where colored particle “molecules” bounce, pass through channels, and get wrapped into vesicles that bud, move along filament “microtubules,” and fuse with organelles.
entries.seed: Cell Membrane Transport and Vesicle Traffic: A transparent spherical cell with a semi-permeable membrane where colored particle “molecules” bounce, pass through channels, and get wrapped into vesicles that bud, move along filament “microtubules,” and fuse with organelles.

entries.title: 3D Neuron Network with Firing Signals
entries.description: Multiple branching neuron-like structures whose axons and dendrites grow, connect, and detach while glowing particles pulse along synapses, with labels for each neuron and a meter showing overall network activity.
entries.seed: 3D Neuron Network with Firing Signals: Multiple branching neuron-like structures whose axons and dendrites grow, connect, and detach while glowing particles pulse along synapses, with labels for each neuron and a meter showing overall network activity.

entries.title: Bacterial Colony Growth on a 3D Surface
entries.description: Rod-shaped bacteria that replicate, slide, and cluster on a light-colored plane, leaving faint trails of secreted “slime,” forming expanding biofilm patches with color changes indicating nutrient-rich vs. depleted regions.

entries.title: Predator–Prey Fish School in a Reef
entries.description: A school of small fish spheres that align, turn, and avoid collisions while a larger predator object chases them, with coral-like stationary obstacles, escape paths leaving short trails, and color shifts when prey are “caught.”

entries.title: 3D Root System Branching through Soil Layers
entries.description: A central root cylinder that grows downward and branches in 3D through semi-transparent soil layers, wrapping around rocks, seeking glowing water pockets that shrink as absorbed and cause localized root thickening.

entries.title: Lung Alveoli Gas Exchange
entries.description: A cluster of semi-transparent alveolar sacs where red and blue particles (O₂ and CO₂) diffuse across thin membranes into and out of branching blood capillary tubes, with changing color gradients showing oxygen saturation.

entries.title: Immune Cell Chasing a Pathogen
entries.description: A large, flexible amoeboid immune cell that crawls and deforms as it chases a smaller bacterium, leaving a faint chemotactic gradient trail, then engulfs it, with internal particles “digesting” and fading it out.

entries.title: DNA Replication and Chromosome Unfolding
entries.description: A coiled chromosome fiber that slowly unravels into a double helix, with replication forks moving in opposite directions, attaching and detaching enzyme “machines” that copy strands and spawn new glowing daughter helices.

entries.title: Cell Division (Mitosis) in 3D
entries.description: A single cell sphere with visible chromosomes that condense, align along a central plane with spindle fibers pulling them apart, then the cell membrane pinches in to split into two labeled daughter cells.
entries.seed: Cell Division (Mitosis) in 3D: A single cell sphere with visible chromosomes that condense, align along a central plane with spindle fibers pulling them apart, then the cell membrane pinches in to split into two labeled daughter cells.

entries.description: A small terrain with plants, herbivores, and predators where objects move, graze, and hunt, and semi-transparent arrows or glowing threads show energy transfer when one organism consumes another, with labels and an energy meter.

entries.description: Red blood cell disks flowing, colliding, and rotating through a branching, semi-transparent vessel system, encountering narrowings where they stack and squeeze, with occasional white cells that stick to vessel walls and then detach.
